editor_ruby_select_exact_error: Select the exact base text that should receive the ruby annotation.

pgs_import_first: Import a source before extracting a PGS track.

project_not_found: Project not found. It may have been moved or deleted. Remove it from Recent Projects or choose another project.
provider_api_key_required: {provider} requires an API key for this session.
provider_model_required: Choose a model in Settings before starting this task.
revision_delete_confirm_description: This revision will be permanently removed. If it is current, the preceding revision becomes effective and the Cue returns to unreviewed.
revision_history_description: All saved versions of Cue {index}, newest first.
revision_history_empty_description: Run OCR or save this Cue to create its first revision.
revision_history_no_cue: Select a Cue to inspect its saved versions.
save_as_choose_location: Choose where to save the project copy
save_as_description: Clone the complete project package with a new identity.
settings_api_key_description: Keys are not written to local preferences or project files.
settings_appearance_description: Appearance follows the shadcn theme tokens across every window.
settings_description: Configure application preferences, project languages, and task models.
settings_debug_logging_description: Records backend operations, project changes, file paths, and complete provider responses. This may reduce performance and increase disk usage. API keys are always redacted.
settings_media_tools_description: Blu-ray analysis and PGS extraction use bundled or system tools.
settings_model_description: Refresh to load models from this provider. A saved model remains selectable while the provider is offline.
settings_reasoning_effort_description: OpenAI reasoning models only. Reasoning tokens are billed at the output rate; recognition and translation need none of it, so "none" is the default.
settings_project_languages_description: These values are used as defaults for OCR and translation jobs.
settings_proper_nouns_description: Store exact source-to-translation forms for this project. These mappings are included in every translation prompt and are not shared with other projects.
settings_proper_nouns_empty: No proper-noun mappings have been added.
settings_separate_ruby_recognition_descr: When enabled, main text is recognized first and a separately configured vision model detects ruby or furigana afterward. This adds one provider request per Cue and may increase processing time and cost.
settings_task_models_description: Text OCR, ruby, style recognition, and translation can use different providers. API keys stay in memory for this app session.
settings_task_ocr_description: Reads the Cue image and recognizes main subtitle text plus ruby or furigana in one vision request. This profile must use a vision-capable model.
settings_task_ocr_separate_description: Reads only the large main subtitle text. Ruby and furigana are intentionally ignored for the separately configured Ruby phase. This profile must use a vision-capable model.
settings_task_ruby_description: Inspects the Cue image after main-text recognition and aligns visible ruby or furigana with exact ranges in the recognized text. This profile must use a vision-capable model.
settings_task_translation_description: Translates the latest OCR or human-edited text into the project target language using adjacent Cues as context. A text-only model is sufficient.
settings_task_validation_description: Inspects the Cue image after recognition to classify whole-Cue italics and a clearly uniform non-white font color. This profile must use a vision-capable model.
debug_log_description: Application, backend, media, storage, and provider diagnostics for this session.
debug_log_empty_description: Enable debug logging in Settings, then reproduce the operation you want to inspect.
debug_log_disabled_description: Enable it in Settings to capture new application activity. Existing entries remain available.
debug_log_no_selection: Select an entry to inspect its structured details.
debug_log_no_data: No data was recorded for this section.
source_description: Select the backup root containing BDMV and CERTIFICATE folders.
status_configure_model: Configure the task model to continue
status_no_earlier_revision: No earlier Cue revision is available
status_ocr_pause_pending: OCR will pause at the next safe Cue boundary
status_ocr_stop_pending: OCR will stop at the next safe Cue boundary
status_revision_restored: Revision restored as a new human edit
welcome_no_recent_description: Projects you create or open will appear here.
workspace_cue_image_aria: Original subtitle cue {index} at its Blu-ray canvas position
workspace_empty_description: Import a Blu-ray source, extract PGS cues, and begin reviewing as OCR results arrive.
workspace_no_cue_description: Choose a cue to edit content, timing, position, and style.
workspace_no_cues_description: Import a source and extract a PGS track to begin.
workspace_timestamp_error: Use HH:MM:SS.mmm timestamps and make End later than Start.
